beats.text: 🗺️ Scouts found its lair — 7 east of here. THE NIELSEN — ratings embodied. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
You walk out to the treeline with everyone who can hold a spear. "Dmitri," you call. "Count them." They count. You count them back.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
The wrongness is the telegraph. (The Callback wears the dead. Speak the funeral — or name it as NOT them.)
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The Callback stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
⚔️ Felipe stood down the Callback and kept walking — 2 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.

🌙 Torches on the doubled watch all night — and The Hungry Road knows what's waiting at the treeline. They know asking again this soon buys nothing either. The night stays quiet, and the watch explains why.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Callback gorges at the treeline — 1,116 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.

🌙 Watchers at the southeast treeline see torchlight moving in The Red Table's camp — and it going dark. Whatever was coming, the doubled watch turned it. The night stays quiet, and everyone at the fire understands why.
